source.stale: cell keeps the rgb block from the generation that was seen
source.tv: uniform random rgb block per clear cell, default_rng(9700+life) per policy
source.random_rng: default_rng(8000+life), one uniform panel per visit
source.reservoir: last 32 glances FIFO per panel for curious_prog and curious_prog_noage; none for curious_surp_forget; curious_prog_lifetime uses W8-1c ObservedReservoir cap 256
source.counts: on each sight, the pixel's 8 grey counts are multiplied by gamma 0.8 and then the sight is added; KT alpha 0.5
source.mover: W7 path_sweep, one cursor per panel, not reset when the image changes
source.optimistic: nearest unvisited on a 4-ring, start panel 0, values start at 0
source.reward: curious_prog and curious_prog_noage sum equation 5 on the last 32 stored glances under the counts before the forgetting update, then learn and store the glance; curious_surp_forget sums mean KT surprise under the forgetting counts; curious_prog_lifetime is W8-1c curious_prog; curious_surp sums per-glance surprise; EMA once per visit
source.age: at the choice, completed decisions minus last_end; last_end is the completed count when the visit ended; greedy step only; stored EMA is not aged
source.noage: curious_prog_noage ranks the raw EMA on the greedy step
source.bootstrap: 10000 paired percentile, numpy quantile linear, default_rng(0) per contrast
